runtime_encoding: lossless aligned uint64 callback address plus one DEMAND/FILL kind bit

neural_action_decoder.request_count: event-local sample from an unweighted learned Bernoulli hurdle plus conditional Poisson excess with unbounded nonnegative integer support
neural_action_decoder.targets: event-local categorical component sample from a free-running autoregressive learned mixture over direct signed cache-line deltas

stochastic_decoding: reproducible RNG streams derived only from the configured run seed
captured_spp_actions_role: fill-preserving normal replay and supervised labels only
training_target: canonicalized source-SPP request count, direct targets, and fill class as supervision only

lstm.architecture: compact single-layer chronological LSTM plus event-local sampled hurdle/Poisson count and free-running autoregressive sampled-component direct-delta/categorical-fill decoder
lstm.stateful_training: chronological TBPTT over the complete demand/fill event sequence; hidden/cell values cross chunks and graph history is detached at chunk boundaries
lstm.inference_history: fresh state followed by complete train, guard, and evaluation chronology

eviction_feedback_role: raw chronological input event only; no private SPP state and no separate eviction prediction target
parameter_counts: measured and asserted exactly; never thresholded
